description: This file is a Streamlit web app page for uploading, processing, and managing PDF chapters related to medical textbooks. It handles file uploads, extracts text, generates embeddings, stores data, and displays existing chapters with options for deletion.

classes.name: LangchainPDFProcessor
classes.description: Processor for extracting text chunks from PDF files using Langchain.

classes.name: EmbeddingManager
classes.description: Manages embedding generation for text chunks.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: Handles storage and retrieval of embeddings in a local vector database.

methods.name: process_pdf
methods.description: Extracts text chunks from a PDF file.

methods.name: batch_embed
methods.description: Generates embeddings for a batch of texts asynchronously.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the vector store from disk.

methods.name: add_embeddings
methods.description: Adds embeddings and associated chunks to the vector store.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the vector store to disk.

methods.name: cascade_delete_chapter
methods.description: Deletes a chapter and all associated data, questions, attempts, and embeddings.
